description: This source file implements a model comparison tool for PyTorch models, loading models, generating inputs, running inference, and comparing outputs within a specified tolerance. It includes command-line argument parsing, multithreading, and output reporting.

methods.name: checkRtol
methods.description: Checks if the maximum difference between tensors is within the specified tolerance.

methods.name: report_pass_rate
methods.description: Reports the rate of successful comparisons within the total number of tests.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a string into a vector of substrings based on a separator character.

methods.name: create_inputs
methods.description: Generates input tensors based on specified dimensions, types, and formats for model comparison.

methods.name: run_check
methods.description: Loads models, runs multiple inference iterations, compares outputs, and reports results.
